quality.hardDesign: 정답을 고르려면 (1) 접촉 조건에서만 채널이 활성화된다는 조건 단서(however, unlike 대조), (2) 감지와 흡수가 동시에 반복적으로 일어난다는 문장 전체의 논리를 종합해야 하며, 태(수동/능동)·구조(명사구/분사구)·시제(완료/진행)라는 서로 다른 문법적 오개념을 가진 선지들이 표면적으로는 모두 그럴듯해 근거 없이는 소거되지 않는다.

problem.passage:
The desert-dwelling thorn lizard Moloch regulates its body temperature not by seeking shade alone but through a specialized skin structure: microscopic channels between its scales draw moisture from damp sand into capillary-like grooves that route water toward the mouth. Physiologists tracking several populations across differing terrains found that this channel network only becomes fully active when the lizard's skin makes direct contact with a moisture source such as dew-covered sand or a shallow puddle; when the lizard rests on dry, sun-baked rock, however, the channels remain largely dormant even if humidity in the surrounding air is high. Unlike species that absorb ambient moisture passively through their skin regardless of substrate, Moloch appears to depend on this contact-triggered mechanism, ______ ground-level moisture through its scales, drawing water toward its mouth only under contact conditions that make hydration efficient rather than wasteful.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: The desert-dwelling thorn lizard Moloch regulates its body temperature not by seeking shade alone but through a specialized skin structure: microscopic channels between its scales draw moisture from damp sand into capillary-like grooves that route water toward the mouth. Physiologists tracking several populations across differing terrains found that this channel network only becomes fully active when the lizard's skin makes direct contact with a moisture source such as dew-covered sand or a shallow puddle; when the lizard rests on dry, sun-baked rock, however, the channels remain largely dormant even if humidity in the surrounding air is high. Unlike species that absorb ambient moisture passively through their skin regardless of substrate, Moloch appears to depend on this contact-triggered mechanism, ______ ground-level moisture through its scales, drawing water toward its mouth only under contact conditions that make hydration efficient rather than wasteful.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 정답 B. 삽입된 분사구는 주절의 주어 'Moloch'를 수식하며, 지문 전체 논리(접촉이 있을 때에만 채널이 활성화되어 수분을 감지하고 동시에 입 쪽으로 물을 끌어당기는 반복적·동시적 과정)를 종합하면, 도마뱀이 지표 수분을 '감지하면서 동시에' 물을 끄는 진행형 현재분사 'sensing'이 필요하다. A 'sensed'는 과거분사로 수동의 의미가 되어 '도마뱀이 감지되다'라는 어색한 의미가 되고 문법적으로 주어와 능동 관계를 이루지 못한다(태 혼동). C 'the sensing of'는 명사구가 되어 콤마 뒤 'drawing'과 이어지는 분사구문 구조를 깨뜨리며, 지문에서 강조하는 '접촉 시에만 작동'이라는 조건성을 단순 명사화하여 인과관계를 흐린다(문장 구조 붕괴). D 'having sensed'는 완료분사로, 감지가 이미 끝난 뒤 별도로 물을 끈다는 순차적 의미가 되어, 지문이 강조하는—접촉이 유지되는 동안 감지와 흡수가 동시에 일어난다는—메커니즘과 어긋난다(시제·동시성 오류). 오답 A, C, D는 모두 '접촉 시 채널 활성화'라는 지문의 핵심 정보 일부를 공유하지만, 태·구조·시제 중 하나를 틀리게 하여 걸러진다.
